name: omarchy-pr-try
description: Test Omarchy PRs safely on your own machine
author: itscallssh

changes: try installs the PR's changed files into the real system (/usr/bin, /usr/share/omarchy, ~/.config) so the running session uses them at once
Originals saved in a root-owned folder with checksums; back restores them and leaves files a package update replaced
New plan command; verify checks each file and PATH shadowing
Failed or interrupted installs are rolled back
Fixed an empty PR banner printed by back after a dev-link
Force-push detection now runs before the risk scan (warns and requires confirmation)
Menu try failures are no longer silently swallowed
New verification block after linking showing PR is active and how to verify it
New verify subcommand and menu item
Explained graphical-session reload requirement in the reboot flow
Install hint when run from an obscure path
Better back output pointing to where downloaded PR code lives
